### ABOUT

Moog's Ocean Structures brings life, fun, and variety to your Minecraft oceans! Dive to explore Atlantean ruins, ancient shipwrecks, ocean temples, and drifting rafts scattered across every water biome. Every structure is built with vanilla blocks and entities, so the mod feels right at home in any modpack and keeps the vanilla feel of the game.

This mod works for Forge, Fabric, and NeoForge. It can also be installed server-side only.

![Features Banner](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/9c87c19a4a12475db5f3270d608ceeb0.png)

To see some of the structures, head to the [images tab](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mos-moogs-ocean-structures/screenshots).

### PREVIEWS

[![Browse every structure live in 3D](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/f8fe835413394a76b10a678afefea30f.png)](https://previews.moogsmods.com/ocean-structures/1.21/)

![Showcase Banner](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/19a44946985740a0b930f07bfd5b7fe7.png)

Checkout the [gallery](https://modrinth.com/mod/mos-moogs-ocean-structures/gallery)

### CONFIG PACK

Every aspect of the mod is customizable using datapacks. Downloadable config packs are published on the [GitHub releases page](https://github.com/FinnSetchell/Moog-s-Ocean-Structures/releases).

For details on how to write and load config datapacks, see the [Moog's Structure Lib wiki](https://github.com/FinnSetchell/MoogsStructureLib/wiki).

### VIDEOS

*If you have any videos featuring this mod that you'd like showcased here, message me on Discord!*

### MODPACKS

See all modpacks using this mod [here](https://www.modpackindex.com/modpack/finder?included_mods=000000).

yungs-better-ocean-monuments.title: YUNG's Better Ocean Monuments
yungs-better-ocean-monuments.description: A complete redesign of Minecraft's ocean monuments!
yungs-better-ocean-monuments.body:
A complete overhaul of Minecraft's ocean monuments! YUNG's Better Ocean Monuments fundamentally redesigns ocean monuments to be much more engaging and rewarding. Better Monuments are much larger than their vanilla counterparts and have completely randomized layouts. You'll find much better loot for your troubles, including Tridents and a Heart of the Sea!


YUNG's Better Ocean Monuments is intended to be fully compatible with every worldgen mod, including:

  • YUNG's Better Desert Temples
  • YUNG's Better Mineshafts
  • YUNG's Better Strongholds
  • YUNG's Extras
  • YUNG's Bridges
  • Repurposed Structures. RS also offers a custom data pack you can use in addition to the mod that adds repurposed versions of these overhauled monuments! Check it out here.

dungeons-and-taverns-ocean-monument-over.title: Dungeons and Taverns Ocean Monument Overhaul
dungeons-and-taverns-ocean-monument-over.description: This Mod/Datapack Overhauls the Ocean Monument, turning it into a jigsaw structure, every room has randomized walls and floors, and some loot chests are scattered around
dungeons-and-taverns-ocean-monument-over.body:
This mod is part of the [Dungeons and Taverns](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dungeon-and-taverns) series, but **does not require** Dungeons and Taverns to work. The main Dungeons and Taverns mod **does NOT include** this mod's features. If you would like more structures similar to this one, then check [my profile!](https://www.curseforge.com/members/nova_wostra/projects)

- Makes Ocean Monuments rarer: is now as rare as Woodland Mansions with 1 apearing in an 80x80 chunk grid and 20 chunks being between 2 Ocean Monuments minimum
- Ocean Monument is now a Jigsaw Structure that uses the full space aviable inside them for rooms
- Ocean Monument is split up into 7 Sections which each have 4 variations
- each room has 3-8 variations depending on room type
- there are 4 wall and 4 door types
- every section of the ocean monument has at least 1 treasure room
- the Elder Guardian Chambers have 3 treasure rooms instead
  - 2 lesser treasure rooms and 1 greater treasure room
- the Top Elder Guardian Chamber has a Greater Treasure chest with 1 guranteed Trident (50%-80% durability)

no-mans-sea.title: No Man's Sea
no-mans-sea.description: This modpack enhances ocean exploration, from underwater structures filled with valuable treasures to pillager warships sailing the seas. It also helps to try and stay away from dry land for the optimal experience.
no-mans-sea.body:
This modpack enhances ocean exploration, from underwater structures filled with valuable treasures to pillager warships sailing the seas. The pack also revamps the Elder Guardian, turning it into a real challenge compared to the joke it once was. If you truly want to experience this modpack in its intended form, try to avoid dry land unless absolutely necessary.

The modpack is still in alpha, so be ready to have things be added or removed. If you find any bugs or have any suggestions to improve on the pack, write it down somewhere, because a discord server is being set up to facilitate your needs.

integrated-seven-seas.title: Integrated Seven Seas
integrated-seven-seas.description: Integrated  Seven Seas is a Mod that overhauls When Dungeons Arise - Seven Seas with integration
integrated-seven-seas.body:
![Integrated Seven Seas](https://i.imgur.com/gcCMXls.png)
# 🌊 Integrated Seven Seas:
**Integrated Seven Seas** is a datapack/mod that overhauls heavily detailed structures of "**When Dungeons Arise - Seven Seas**", using blocks and mobs from Quark, Create, Supplementaries, and Farmer's Delight. Aditionally to all this, all the interiors designs of the structures have been revamped, with more enemies as well and a rebalanced loot for the early gameplay.

# 💻 Features:
- **Structure Generation:** This mod/datapack improves the generation of all the ships, allowing them to spawn in the deep oceans only with smooth ocean around to avoid them getting close to other structures.

- **Worldgen Compatibility:** Lucky, Integrated API got their own tags for compatibility with other worldgen mods.

- **Loot Tables:** Another big revamp, was for all the loot tables of the mod, this was a big issue with the original mod that I decide to adrees by making the loot only worth it if you loot all the structure. 

# ✒️ Credits:
This datapack/mod was a rework of all the structures of **["When Dungeons Arise - Seven Seas"](https://modrinth.com/mod/when-dungeons-arise-seven-seas)** made by **Aurelj**, the main author of the original mod.

# 📝 Frequently Asked Questions:
**❔ What biome mods are compatible?**
- ✅ Most biome and worldgen mods should be compatible, there are few mods that add some "deep ocean" biome.

**❔Why are there so many dependencies? Can I play without them?**
- ✅ The core idea behind the Integrated series (originally inspired by Integrated Dungeons and Structures) is to seamlessly weave mechanics, blocks, and content from other popular mods into the world to make it feel truly alive and interconnected. Because the structures are natively built around these modded assets, there are no plans for a 100% Vanilla version. Removing the dependencies would require redesigning the structures and would destroy the main concept of the mod.

**❔ Can I use this in my modpack?**
- ✅ Yes! This project was made for go in company of IDAS and his addons, but if you use all the dependencies by itself, everything should be fine.

**❔ How can I config this mod?**
- ✅ Since this mod is data-driven, it uses the standard vanilla datapack format. You can customize it by opening the file and modifying the internal data just like you would with any vanilla datapack.

**❔ Why is the Victory Frigate missing?**
- ✅ This structure is a mess for gameplay since it is massive for being in the ocean, without mentioning that has a lot of wool. I have no plans in add it unless I find a way to balance it and motivation to do it.

aquamirae.body:
###
Aquamirae expands your world with a frozen ocean biome – the Ice Maze above and a haunting Ship Graveyard beneath. Discover its unique ecosystem, progression, ambience, and lore as you uncover the fate of Captain Cornelia and survive the horrors lurking below the ice.


### “ 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘰𝘯𝘤𝘦 𝘦𝘯𝘥𝘭𝘦𝘴𝘴 𝘰𝘤𝘦𝘢𝘯, 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘸𝘢𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘴 𝘰𝘧 𝘸𝘩𝘪𝘤𝘩 𝘸𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘳𝘢𝘪𝘴𝘦𝘥 𝘧𝘳𝘰𝘮 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘥𝘦𝘱𝘵𝘩𝘴 𝘣𝘺 𝘨𝘶𝘴𝘵𝘺 𝘸𝘪𝘯𝘥𝘴, 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘰𝘤𝘦𝘢𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘸𝘢𝘴 𝘴𝘢𝘪𝘭𝘦𝘥 𝘣𝘺 𝘣𝘳𝘢𝘷𝘦 𝘷𝘰𝘺𝘢𝘨𝘦𝘳𝘴 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘧𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘴𝘰𝘮𝘦 𝘧𝘭𝘰𝘵𝘪𝘭𝘭𝘢𝘴 𝘰𝘧 𝘱𝘪𝘭𝘭𝘢𝘨𝘦𝘳𝘴, 𝘪𝘴 𝘯𝘰𝘸 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘪𝘯𝘦𝘥 𝘪𝘯 𝘪𝘤𝘦 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘴𝘯𝘰𝘸. ### 𝘍𝘳𝘰𝘻𝘦𝘯 𝘪𝘯 𝘵𝘪𝘮𝘦… 𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘴𝘩𝘪𝘱𝘴 𝘰𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘰𝘴𝘦 𝘸𝘩𝘰 𝘸𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘶𝘯𝘭𝘶𝘤𝘬𝘺 𝘧𝘳𝘰𝘻𝘦 𝘪𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘮𝘦𝘳𝘤𝘪𝘭𝘦𝘴𝘴 𝘪𝘤𝘦, 𝘢𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘴𝘢𝘮𝘦 𝘮𝘰𝘮𝘦𝘯𝘵 𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘳𝘪𝘣𝘭𝘦 𝘤𝘳𝘦𝘢𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘦𝘴 𝘤𝘳𝘢𝘸𝘭𝘦𝘥 𝘰𝘶𝘵 𝘰𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘢𝘣𝘺𝘴𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘭𝘪𝘨𝘩𝘵 𝘰𝘧 𝘥𝘢𝘺. 𝘛𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘶𝘨𝘩 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘣𝘭𝘪𝘻𝘻𝘢𝘳𝘥, 𝘰𝘯𝘭𝘺 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘳𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘴𝘰𝘶𝘯𝘥𝘴 𝘰𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘩𝘰𝘳𝘯𝘴 𝘰𝘧 𝘵𝘩𝘰𝘴𝘦 𝘸𝘩𝘰 𝘴𝘵𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘩𝘰𝘱𝘦 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘳𝘦𝘴𝘤𝘶𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘩𝘦𝘢𝘳𝘥. 𝘞𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘤𝘰𝘶𝘭𝘥 𝘵𝘳𝘢𝘯𝘴𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘰𝘯𝘤𝘦 𝘶𝘯𝘣𝘳𝘪𝘥𝘭𝘦𝘥 𝘰𝘤𝘦𝘢𝘯 𝘴𝘰 𝘥𝘳𝘢𝘴𝘵𝘪𝘤𝘢𝘭𝘭𝘺? ”

The Ice Maze

A frozen labyrinth rises above a sunken ship graveyard, forming a two-layered biome filled with danger and secrets. Explore twisting corridors, collapsed decks, hidden chambers, and the silent wrecks buried beneath the ice.

Structures & Atmosphere

From abandoned camps to massive frozen wrecks, every corner of the biome offers places to explore and stories to uncover. Custom music, eerie ambient sounds, and drifting snow turn each expedition into an atmospheric journey.

Creatures Beneath the Ice

Terrifying spawn of the abyss have risen to the surface, driving local raider flotillas into hiding. These creatures don’t simply inhabit the maze – they spill out from beneath the ice, pushing anyone who dares approach into the most remote corners in search of safety.

Captain Cornelia

The ghostly captain guards the heart of the ship graveyard with fluid animations and deadly abilities. Her tragic story unfolds through the environment and the treasures she leaves behind.

Treasure & Customization

Discover unique weapons, armor sets with special bonuses, and rare trinkets scattered throughout the biome. With full config support, you can fine-tune generation, difficulty, loot, and every feature to fit your world perfectly.


Aquamirae Delight by tinfoilknight

Aquamirae Delight is a compatibility mod for Farmer's Delight and Aquamirae. It introduces new dishes and enhanced recipes while staying true to the themes, ingredients, and gameplay style of both mods, preserving a cohesive vanilla-like experience.

shrines.body:
![](https://bisecthosting.com/images/CF/ShrinesStructures/bh\_header.png)

[![](https://bisecthosting.com/images/CF/ShrinesStructures/bh\_promo.png)](https://bisecthosting.com/SHRINES)

### News

Shrines for 1.20.1 is out, now even as datapack to be used with vanilla minecrfat. For this reason, some features were removed.

For information on version for old Minecraft versions and their features visit [GitHub](https://github.com/Silverminer007/Shrines/blob/1.19.x-5.x.x/DESCRIPTION.md)

![Spotlights Header](https://bisecthosting.com/images/CF/ShrinesStructures/bh\_1.png)

**All credits to the content creator of these Spotlights (Lady Jessa aka lady\_jessa on CurseForge)**

[![Spotlight Video Thumbnail](http://img.youtube.com/vi/Y72eAz8uq9E/0.jpg)](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y72eAz8uq9E "Abandoned Villa Spotlight")

![Introduction](https://bisecthosting.com/images/CF/ShrinesStructures/bh\_2.png)

Shrines is a uniquely customizable, rapidly expanding structure generation mod that is updated from time to time. Minecraft's structures have their own style that should be respected, so Shrines never replaces pre-existing structures. Instead, this mod adds a new variety of diverse builds custom created to enhance Minecraft gameplay. A shrine is a monument, a structure with a distinctive purpose. Each one has a story to tell. Be a part of the story!

![Oriental Sanctuary](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/387/686/oriental\_sanctuary.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/gci7HHf.png)

japanese-offering-shrines.title: Japanese Offering Shrines
japanese-offering-shrines.description: Discover forgotten traditional japanese shrines in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, wich can be found in two different variations in forests and cherry grove biomes.
japanese-offering-shrines.body:
![Cherryo Blossom Shrine](https://i.imgur.com/G4XYxTQ.jpeg)

Step into the past and explore the enigmatic world of **forgotten offering shrines** with the **Japanese Offering Shrines Mod!** This mod introduces realistically generated shrines ruins into Minecraft, appearing in **cherry groves and forests.** Each shrine captures the mysterious aura of the real-world monument, making your world feel alive with history and ancient secrets.

![Forest Shrine](https://i.imgur.com/QzgXmpX.jpeg)

Perfect for players who enjoy **exploration, world-building, and discovering landmarks with cultural and historical inspiration**, these shrines serve as unique points of interest to enrich your Minecraft adventures.

![Forest Shrine](https://i.imgur.com/r5KkMgH.jpeg)

Whether you're a **solo explorer or part of a multiplayer server**, these shrines bring **atmospheric depth, realism, and storytelling potential** to your world.

japanese-temple.title: Japanese Temple - Structure ✅
japanese-temple.description: A Japanese Temple is a tranquil in plains complex in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by traditional Shinto and Buddhist architecture, featuring sweeping curved eaves, tiered pagodas and torii gates, stone lanterns, and wooden joinery.
japanese-temple.body:
![1](https://i.imgur.com/I4gBN32.png)

![2](https://i.imgur.com/iEmURfm.png)

Japanese Temple Mod for Minecraft transforms your plains into a tranquil Japanese temple complex in a vanilla-friendly style. Inspired by traditional Shinto and Buddhist architecture, the mod adds tiered pagodas, towering torii gates, sweeping curved eaves, koi ponds, stone lanterns and manicured zen gardens—creating authentic, photogenic points of interest that blend seamlessly with the plains biome. Perfect for builders, explorers and creative servers, this Japanese temple mod for Minecraft brings atmosphere and cultural detail without breaking the vanilla aesthetic.

![3](https://i.imgur.com/8GyyNIW.png)

The mod features natural generation in the plains biome, handcrafted wooden joinery and decorative blocks designed to match vanilla textures, hidden meditation chambers and secret passages for rewarding exploration, and multiple structure sizes to suit solo builds or grand server landmarks. With carefully placed ponds, stone paths and lanterns, every temple feels intentional and immersive, offering new storytelling and screenshot opportunities for map makers and roleplay communities.

![4](https://i.imgur.com/PJRr6WK.png)

Easy to install and optimized for performance, Japanese Temple Mod is compatible with common Minecraft setups and suitable for both single-player and multiplayer servers. Whether you’re creating an adventure map, a serene photo spot, or a cultural landmark, download the mod to add a corner of calm and beauty to your plains—bring traditional Japanese architecture into your Minecraft world today.

_Build credits to zzFreeKill_

panda-temple.description: Spawns a mysterious overgrown temple in the jungle inhabited by our favorite bamboo eating creature!
panda-temple.body:
# Welcome to Panda Temple!

## Introduction
Pandas in Minecraft are extremely rare, but have you ever wondered why that is? Maybe this structure will shine a light on a forgotten civilization that would do anything to care for their favorite animals. It looks like a lovely place, or is there more to it than meets the eye?


## Features
This datapack adds the Panda Temple which spawns in the Jungle biome. It houses pandas, parrots, frogs, and ocelots. While you can just get the animals, you can also explore further to try and find valuable stuff that is protected in a way that you want to be in the end game with enchanted gear and tools to stand a chance (or find a creative way to obtain it). 

<details>
<summary>/locate command</summary>

/locate structure pandatemple:pandatemple

</details>

If you have a cool idea to make this datapack better, please make a suggestion in my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/YPgxKKb2Mr)!

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/z0qJSbtP/images/ee8fef9a1614c18075ac0e9397efc6b3e25df4e9.png)



<details>
<summary>Credits</summary>

Shoutout to @Navelpluus who designed the temple!

</details>

blades-temples.body:
# Welcome to Blade's Temples!

This Mod adds 5 new structures to the base game, without replacing existing structures to preserve the vanilla feel:
## The Desert Palace:
![The Desert Palace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/20d46qa1/images/a5082fc868d266f261d87adaae8b1685928903c5.png)
A Majestic palace that spawns in the desert.
Inside the Desert palace, you'll find the all-too-familiar purple concrete block in the middle. Mine it, and you'll fall the bottom section of the Palace, filled with loot! But beware, Palace Guards & Knights roam the halls, and will stop at nothing to defeat you.
<details>
<summary>Available Loot</summary>
The following can be found in chests, barrels, and decorative pots:
1. cooked_beef
2. stick
3. sandstone
4. emerald
5. cobweb
6. sand
7. rotten_flesh
8. arrow
9. gunpowder
10. redstone
11. bucket
12. ender_pearl
13. string
14. iron_ingot
15. diamond
16. golden_apple
17. enchanted_golden_apple
18. brick

(note that not all items can be found in pots or barrels, and certain items are rare)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Mobs</summary>
Palace Guardians:
In each temple there are 4 locations where OP loot chests generate, inside these spaces also spawns "Palace Guardians", each having 1 totem of undying, diamond armor, a diamond sword, 100 health points(50 hearts total), and can deal 5.0 base damage (2.5 hearts).

All throughout the bottom of the temple, there are also "Palace Knights", with a default health of 50 points(25 hearts), each having an iron sword, a mixture of armor(leather, chainmail, gold).
</details>
<details>
  <summary>Values</summary>
    "separation": 25,
    "spacing": 50,
    "blades-temples:desert/palace/palace"
</details>



## The Jungle Temple:
![The Jungle Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/20d46qa1/images/a340610d90fc92dda387069ec23527364e5a2755.png)
Hidden deep within the dense jungle, this rare and mysterious Jungle Temple awaits discovery. The upper level offers only minimal loot, a mere teaser of the treasures that lie beneath. But for adventurers seeking a greater challenge, flick the lever at the heart of the temple to unlock the hidden lower chamber.

Be on guard, near every lower chest is a trail spawner, capable of summoning swarms of new bogged creatures and relentless zombies. Only the brave and skilled will survive the trials and claim the temple's true riches!
<details>
<summary>Available Loot</summary>
The following can be found in chests and barrels: 
1. iron_pickaxe
2. iron_boots
3. iron_leggings
4. iron_chestplate
5. iron_helmet
6. skeleton_skull
7. stick
8. moss_block
9. bamboo
10. melon
11. iron_boots (enchanted)
12. iron_leggings (enchanted)
13. iron_chestplate (enchanted)
14. iron_helmet (enchanted)
15. emerald
16. diamond
17. cobweb
18. arrow
19. bone
20. golden_apple
21. enchanted_golden_apple
22. rotten_flesh
23. leather_boots
24. leather_leggings
25. leather_helmet
</details>
<details>
<summary>Mobs</summary>
  The trial spawners can spawn either bogged or zombies. These entities values have not been modified.
</details>
<details>
  <summary>Values</summary>
    "separation": 25,
    "spacing": 50,
    "blades-temples:jungle/temple"
</details>

## The Dark Forest Temple:
![The Dark Forest Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/20d46qa1/images/cf51e1d9820d6c70425b0ba982966c8d6adb97be.png)
The Dark Forest Temple spawns within the Dark Forests, obscured by the looming trees. Finding the Temple is a treat, and offers Tons of loot! But Beware of the TNT hidden below, otherwise you'll be in for an EXPLOSIVE surprise!
<details>

The following can be found in chests:

<details>

    "spacing": 50,

</details>

## The Plains Temple:
![The Plains Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/20d46qa1/images/921ea7a830ca4090c7c1363c876d642ff9535a55.png)
A simple temple found within the plains biome. It contains varied loot, but beware of the darkness - in every dark area exists spawners - alongside naturally spawning mobs.
<details>

The following can be found in chests:

![The Badlands Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/20d46qa1/images/a847d021887cf0ef6b3ac44f5d195c33821e2090.png)
This new Temple(added in version 1.0.2 of the mod) naturally spawns inside the Badlands biome. The Chests and barrels are filled with LOOT!

YUNG's Better Jungle Temples includes built-in compatibility with many mods! If you're using any of the following mods, certain parts of the temple have a chance of spawning using special pieces. Note that this is an optional feature — these mods are not required to use Better Jungle Temples.

yungs-better-desert-temples.description: A complete redesign of Minecraft's desert temples!
yungs-better-desert-temples.body:
The ultimate upgrade to Minecraft's desert temples! YUNG's Better Desert Temples redesigns vanilla desert temples to be way more exciting, adding a variety of new puzzles, traps, & parkour challenges. And of course, you'll get much better loot than vanilla's desert temples for your troubles!

By default, mining fatigue will be applied to all players in the Better Desert Temple. Once you clear the temple (i.e. kill the pharaoh at the end of the temple), the mining fatigue effect for that temple will be permanently lifted! You can disable this feature in the config. Additionally, you can re-enable vanilla desert temples to spawn alongside Better Desert Temples in the config.

integrated-stronghold.title: Integrated Stronghold
integrated-stronghold.description: Integrated Stronghold is a mod that replaces the old and bland vanilla stronghold structure with a heavily detailed dungeon built with modded blocks from Create, Quark, and Supplementaries.
integrated-stronghold.body:
FOR FORGE/FABRIC 1.19.2, 1.18.2, & 1.20.1

![This is an image](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/IntegratedStronghold/BH_NU_HEADER.webp)

Required Mods:

Integrated API 

Create

Supplementaries

Quark (forge only)




Optional Integrated Mods:

Biomes You'll Go

Biomes O' Plenty

Waystones

Farmer's Delight

Hexerei

Ars Nouvea

Mowzie's Mobs (1.18 only)

End Remastered (Datapack needed)

Alex's Mobs (Datapack needed)

The Graveyard (Datapack needed)

Dungeons Mobs (Datapack needed)

__________________________________________________________________________________________

 

WHAT IS INTEGRATED STRONGHOLD?
   

Integrated Stronghold is the second mod in the Integrated Structure series (the first being IDAS). Not only does it completely overhaul the boring old Minecraft stronghold structure with tons of heavily detailed rooms to explore, but it integrates Supplementaries/Quark decorations and Create mod doors, puzzles, traps, and more. It is the biggest generated structure dungeon you have ever explored, it takes up the maximum size possible in Minecraft. Additionally, it greatly expands upon the lore of the stronghold in Minecraft through lore books found in chests. I got sick of installing structure mods into a pack and roaming the world, only to find vanilla items and nothing of difficulty anywhere. I love detailed builds and Create machines, so I decided to make mods that adds exactly what I’ve been missing. Beautiful and challenging dungeons and structures packed with lore that are fully integrated into multiple core mods.


It is compatible with other stronghold mods (such as Yung's Better Strongholds) but it is HIGHLY recommended you only use this mod to preserve the integrated feeling and original intent.


I HIGHLY RECCOMEND USING ONE OR ALL OF THE OPTIONAL DATAPACKS TO ADD UNIQUE MOBS AND COMBAT

[Trailer video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bUFqx_kgi1c)

Configuration and optional Integration:

To enable optional integration, download these datapacks

End Remastered
Alex's Mobs
The Graveyard
Dungeons Mobs
If there is a mobs mod you want integrated, let me know!
 

To configure anything else, download this datapack

To change the spawn rate, change the spacing and separation in the structures set file. Spacing is the Average distance between two neighboring generation attempts. Value between 0 and 4096
Separation is the Minimum distance in chunks between two neighboring attempts. Value between 0 and 4096. Can't be bigger than spacing
To edit biomes, edit the biome files in tags/worldgen/biome/has structure
To change what mobs spawn throughout the structure, edit the integrated_structure_spawners files. Adding mobs to these is fairy straightforward, take a look at one of the optional datapacks if you need an example
 

Note: To use datapacks on a server, I recommend using a global datapack mod or KubeJS

 

Features:

Over 50 unique heavily detailed dungeon rooms making the experience different every time:

-  Unique small and detailed rooms including study rooms, kitchens, armories, mines, and more

-  Massive rooms to explore and uncover the secrets of including the portal room, grand library, dining hall, and more

-  Medium sized rooms such as prisons, fountains, enchanting rooms, portal rooms, and more

-  Tons of variations of trapped hallways to keep you on your toes

-  2 Custom made music discs by Cama to breath life into the stronghold. One can be found be crafting disc fragments found in the stronghold.

-  Lore books hidden in chests expanded upon the Minecraft lore greatly and giving the stronghold a true backstory and purpose in your world, while still leaving room for the player to piece together it's history.

-  Customized loot, weapons, and tools matching the lore books.

-  Create mod puzzles and traps to navigate

- Join my discord to make suggestions and influence my future projects!

 

If you have trouble finding the stronghold, use Eye of Enders to locate it or use "/locate integrated_stronghold:stronghold"

 

Frequently Asked Questions:

Q: What biome mods are compatible?

A: Most biome mods are compatible including Terralith, BOP, and BYG.

 

Q: Why are there so many dependencies?

A: Yes.


Q: Will you backport/update to ___?

A: I will always keep the mod up to date with the newest versions of Minecraft as the dependencies update. I am also currently working on the port to fabric

 

Q: Does this mod work with other structures mods?

A: Yes all of Yung's mods, Repurposed Structures and more will all work but it is HIGHLY recommended you only use this Stronghold overhaul mod. YUNG's Stronghold is good but the detail and integration put into this mod makes it miles more immersive and a better experience overall without question in my opinion. If you don't believe me try it out for yourself!

 

Q: Can I use this mod in a modpack?

A: Yes! I would love it if this mod gets used in packs.

 

Q: Can this mod be only on the server-side?
A: No, due to its custom music discs and soundtrack

 

Q: What features from Quark can be disabled? 

A: All of the technical changes and Redstone can be disabled without problem. IDAS uses all the building blocks though.

WHAT IS INTEGRATED DUNGEONS AND STRUCTURES?

          Integrated Dungeons and Structures (aka IDAS) is a mod that adds heavily detailed structures using blocks and mobs from Quark, Alex’s Mobs, and Create, with optional integrated with many other mods. I got sick of installing structure mods into a pack and roaming the world, only to find vanilla items and nothing of difficulty anywhere. I love detailed builds and Create machines, so I decided to make a mod that adds exactly what I’ve been missing. Beautiful and challenging dungeons and structures packed with lore that are fully integrated into multiple core forge mods.   If you’re new to this mod I highly recommend locating a Labyrinth, Tinker’s Workshop, Ancient Mines or a Pillager Fortress and playing through it. Those took by FAR the most time to build and I believe they are genuinely very fun and rewarding. Good luck!   Check out my other projects! * Integrated Minecraft, the official modpack for the Integrated Structures series * Integrated Stronghold
 * Integrated Villages   Configuration and optional Integration:

For 1.16

Edit the config files
IDAS automatically detects if Ice and Fire is installed and will change some structures loot and mobs


For 1.18 and above
To enable BOP integration, download this datapack.
To enable Alex's Mobs integrated, download this datapack

To configure anything else, download this datapack

  • To change spawn rates change the spacing and separation in the structures sets. Spacing is the Average distance between two neighboring generation attempts. Value between 0 and 4096
    Separation is the Minimum distance in chunks between two neighboring attempts. Value between 0 and 4096. Can't be bigger than spacing
  • To edit biomes, edit the biome files in tags/worldgen/biome/has structure
  • To disable structures, remove all the biomes for their tag list or raise the separation and spacing to crazy high numbers
  • To improve compatibility with other structure mods, add structures to the “structure set to avoid” list in each of the worldgen/configured_structure_feature files

 

Note: When using the global datapacks mod, if you’re using both the BOP and config data packs, you have to manually make sure that the data pack for bop integration is above the config data pack.

  Features and Planned features:

Over 50 unique heavily detailed structures in the Overworld and Nether dimensions including:

-  20 unique small and detailed world building structures such as campsites, markets, animal dens, and more

-  7 Endgame level dungeons ranging from expansive dwarven mines to the desert Labyrinth to the Pillager Fortress

-  Create themed Dungeons with spinning death traps such as the Tinker's Workshop

-  15 unique houses and inns for weary travelers

 - 6 magical wizard and enchanting towers to explore

-  Sunken pirate ships

-  Villager Castles

-  Magic towers and portals to explore in the nether

-  Event based structures such as the Winter Wagon and Haunted Manor

 

Planned Features:

 

- Underground dungeon variants

- More Nether and End structures

- Join my discord to make suggestions and vote on what structures get added next!

 

If you have trouble finding one of these structures, just start typing `/locate idas` into the chat and you should find a list of all the structures. For example, typing `/locate idas:castle` will find the closest Castle to your location.

philips-ruins.title: Philips Ruins
philips-ruins.description: This mod adds ancient ruins to your Minecraft world
philips-ruins.body:
![Title](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/569737/description_c050e312-212d-4723-aa7b-e6c72c16585b.png)
Philip’s Ruins is a Minecraft ruins generator mod for Forge and Fabric, and it supports the latest Minecraft versions to date. The mod adds over 190 different types of ruin variants to the game, each with their own unique custom loot tables. This includes some hidden bosses that you can discover while exploring the lost remnants of ruins. The mod aims to add ancient ruins similar to what you see in real life by introducing lore to Minecraft, thereby enhancing gameplay functionality.
Two interesting features of this mod are:
- Most loot will likely be buried underground or covered with stones from the ruins.
- Unlike other structure mods, Philip’s Ruins makes most of its structures look like actual ruins. 

This is achieved by blending the ruin with the terrain instead of having a rigid drop-off at the end of a structure, which is common in most mods during rough terrain generation.
This approach makes the ruins you come across look like they were there before any other structures, like villages, came to pass. It gives a vintage, ancient look to the current ruins, maintaining the structure along with terrain erosion.

[![Philip's Ruins Data Pack](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/569737/description_5a9bfc02-4142-472d-ae48-c730fa75ef26.png "Philip's Ruins Data Packet")](https://modrinth.com/datapack/philips-ruins-datapack)

If you would like to support the mod’s development, join our Discord server. We post updates on what’s going on with the community, and you’re free to ask questions about the mod or any other topic. Also, if you would like to join our Patreon, click the Patreon button. We really appreciate the support, and every contribution goes to our team. Patrons will get a shout-out during the description of the mod and on our YouTube channel. So far, here are some people who have contributed to this project.

[![Cubus Studio](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/569737/description_8226cee9-f32c-414b-8185-4dedbcfae151.png "Cubus Studio")](https://discord.gg/rxnBrcWP5R)
